name: typeset
label: Typeset
tagline: Typst documents, CVs and letters to PDF

help.about: Write documents, CVs and letters from a template and turn them into PDFs.

manifest.summary: Write in Typst on the left, see the pages on the right as you type, Export PDF puts <name>.pdf beside the document. Each document is a folder in ~/Documents/Typeset holding main.typ and its pictures; Typst only reads inside that folder. New documents start from templates/ (templates.json is the registry: blank, report, CV, letter). Typst is pinned in typeset.json and fetched once through shared/forge_fetch.py.
